I have 0.11 hectares here for maize, intercropped with beans near the house. Last season I put two wheelbarrows of cow manure on this plot and bought a small share of fertilizer from the cooperative, and the cobs were much better than the year before, so I will do the same again. My cousin in the next village had good luck with improved seed last year, so I will plant that too, but I will not waste money on chemicals for such a small piece — my wife and I can weed it by hand with our hoes. We depend on the rains here in Iringa, so I will not irrigate; this plot should take us about ten days of work from planting to harvest.
